thread:
Marta Chen: quick FYI — billing-bot flagged a hosted spend drift for KiteFlow this week. Commit $10k/mo vs current burn ~$15.2k, variance ~52%.

billing-bot: ALERT: hosted_spend_drift | customer=KiteFlow | commit=10000 | 7d_spend=10645 | 30d_spend=15230 | reason=unexpected API burst | flag=anomaly

Jamie Ortiz: ugh, that's sizable. Is it sustained or a short burst?

Marta Chen: looks like bursty calls over 3 days. Token/p60 spiked from 120k -> 780k. I pulled the top endpoints:
```
SELECT endpoint, sum(tokens) FROM request_logs WHERE customer='kiteflow' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY sum(tokens) DESC LIMIT 5;
```

Vikram Rao: do we have latency or error correlation? Could be retries looping.

Marta Chen: latency clear — 95p latency up 3x on their `batch-embed` route during spike. Error rate slid from 0.1% -> 0.9% for the same time window.

Tess Nguyen: pinging SE to see if they rolled a new job. @Jamie can you take point on outreach? Recommend soft cap and suggested quota until we confirm root cause.

Jamie Ortiz: on it. I'll draft note: "we've detected a sustained usage increase that may exceed your commit — temporarily capping to protect against overage. Please confirm if this is expected." Send in 10.

Marta Chen: also flagged for alerting: set ticket CS-4879, label: high-priority, renewal-risk. Add recommended next steps: 1) confirm internal job/cron 2) enable prefix caching 3) consider short-term upgraded commit or temporary burst plan.

billing-bot: Ticket created: CS-4879 by Marta Chen. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/CS-4879

Vikram Rao: For engineering context — we should look at their model variant too. If they're routing to larger model or non-quantized variant that could explain token cost jump.

Jamie Ortiz: outreach sent. Copy of message:
```
Hi KiteFlow — we observed a sharp increase in hosted API usage that may breach your monthly commit. We're temporarily pausing burst capacity above commit while we investigate. Please reply if this is expected or provide the job id causing the spike.
```

Tess Nguyen: thanks. I'll schedule a quick sync with the account tomorrow 9am PT. @billing-bot, please pause surge billing alerts for 2 hours while CS touches base.

billing-bot: surge_alerts_paused | customer=KiteFlow | duration=2h | by=Tess Nguyen

Marta Chen: perfect. I'll follow up after the call — if it's intentional we propose two options: nudge commit to $20k/mo or enable controlled burst with caps and notification thresholds.

Jamie Ortiz: noted. will update CS-4879 with call notes and next action.

Marta Chen: :thumbsup:
